gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints enterprise columns Landfill Fund, Electric Fund, Combined System Utilities Fund (Internal Service Funds column not used); detail has no business-type lines. The JSON receipts are total operating revenues 86,992,033 + nonoperating interest income 2,741,235 + participation and capacity agreements 1,547,329 + net coal sales 1,356,686 + miscellaneous income 969,019 + loss on disposal of capital assets (442,187) = 93,164,115, so the same rows go in section revenue (loss negative, as on the statement lines). Landfill 2,648,615 + 12,119 + 308,589 = 2,969,323; Electric 56,018,465 + 1,787,917 + 1,547,329 + 1,356,686 - 247,900 + 683,119 = 61,145,616; Combined System Utilities 28,312,834 + 644,729 - 194,287 + 285,900 = 29,049,176. 2,969,323 + 61,145,616 + 29,049,176 = 93,164,115 = gap. The governmental revenue/expenditure gaps were explained by the first pass (different basis) and are not repeated.
